assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE masked-alpha FOLIAGE CARD texture variant for a hand-painted fantasy dungeon game. Subject: A single hanging broad-leaf ivy vine, slender main stem anchored at the TOP CENTER and descending naturally, with 2 to 3 short side tendrils and rounded heart-shaped leaves in small irregular clusters. Lush but airy, about 14 to 22 clearly readable leaves, varied sizes, a tapered trailing end. Classic healthy woodland ivy with dark olive greens and restrained sage painted accents. Composition: a single complete botanical clump/strand on a tall PORTRAIT 512x1024 canvas, plant fully visible, centered horizontally, narrow enough to have substantial transparent margins left and right and about 5 percent clear space above and below. No part of the silhouette may hit or be clipped by any image edge. This is one individual card, NOT a scene, not a square tiling leaf carpet, not a grid or collection of separate samples. Style: VERY CLEARLY PAINTERLY gouache/oil game art, broad visible directional brushstrokes, simplified painted color planes, carefully painted veins, a few readable shadow/midtone/highlight shapes. No photographic leaf fibers or realistic microtexture, no CGI plastic, no outlines, no pixel art. Uniform soft ambient material lighting, dark rich shadows inside the plant, no cast shadow on a background, no directional lighting gradient. Alpha: REAL TRANSPARENT background, completely opaque solid leaf/stem interiors and clean crisp cutout silhouettes, only narrow edge antialiasing. No translucent leaf bodies, no glow or bright yellow/green halo, no keyed green background, no black/white backing, no fake checkerboard. No text, labels, borders, props or extraneous elements. Clean botanical card art suitable for alphaTest 0.5.

Output ONE asset on a SQUARE 1024x1024 canvas with REAL transparent background, fully visible, centered, about 8 percent clear margin on every edge. No seedheads, wheat, cattails, reeds, flowers, soil mound or rock. Front/three-quarter botanical cutout for an upright crossed card.
